description: Graphite drawing of a canyon with a plateau in the foreground and a hill and two plateaus in the background. There are bumps along the canyon floor that appear to be plants. This artwork has *Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)*, 1916–1917 (cat. no. 153) on the back.
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
